who: Software engineering teams and open-source maintainers who receive bug reports and need multiple AI-generated patch strategies evaluated objectively before merging any fix.
agent_work: The agent clones the target repository inside an isolated Celesto sandbox, applies one of four patch strategies, runs the project test suite, starts the app for preview, and captures a screenshot as verification evidence.
proof_output: A ranked leaderboard of candidate patches with test pass/fail counts, diff sizes, preview URLs, and a deterministic judge score for each strategy.
